name: Amalekites
overview: The Amalekites were a people dwelling in the southern territory near Idumea and east of the Red Sea, frequently opposing Israel as recorded in Scripture. They engaged Israel in battle at Rephidim, where Joshua defeated them by the sword, and God declared a perpetual conflict against Amalek, promising to erase their memory from under heaven. Throughout Israel’s history, the Amalekites faced multiple defeats by leaders such as Chedorlaomer, Joshua, Gideon, Saul, David, and the Simeonites, yet they also at times overcame Israel. God commanded Israel to destroy the Amalekites, underscoring their role as persistent enemies and fulfilling divine judgment upon them.
